text.tspan: The FALCON030 cartridge port is fully compatible with ST cartridge. The cartridge is
physically connected through a 40 pin card edge connector ROM cartridge slot. Cartridge ROMs
are mapped to a 128K memory region starting at 0x00FA0000, extending to 0x00FBFFFF.
If not in a plastic housing, the cartridge must be installed with the chips facing down.The
cartridge uses a 40 pin card edge S connector with the following pin assignment:
The MIDI allows the integration of the FALCON030 series with music synthesizers, sequencers,
drum boxes, and other devices possessing MIDI interfaces. High speed (31.25 Kbaud) serial
communication of keyboard and program information is provided by two ports, MIDI OUT and
MIDI IN (the MIDI OUT also includes MIDI THRU data).
The MIDI communicates through the MC6850 Asynchronous Communications Interface
Adapter (ACIA) to the system bus. The data transfer rate is a constant 31.25 Kbaud of 8-bit
